name: Custom Click Buffer
description: Buffers orb clicks by 1-5 frames, with an experimental predictive mode that delays a click that would kill you.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the whole mod on or off.

frames.name: Orb Buffer Window (frames)
frames.description: If you click up to this many frames before touching an orb, the mod activates the orb for you (1-5). It never holds your button longer than you did.

player2.name: Buffer Player 2
player2.description: Also buffer orb clicks for player 2 (dual mode).

show-hud.name: Show On-Screen Feedback
show-hud.description: Shows a small readout in the bottom-left of the level: what the mod just did, plus running counts.

predictive.name: Predictive Press (EXPERIMENTAL)
predictive.description: When you click, simulate the next moments. If the click would kill you, hold it back up to the delay below and fire it on the first frame that survives. Can lag or glitch music. Player 1 only.

pred-delay.name: Max Press Delay (frames)
pred-delay.description: The furthest the mod may delay a click to save you (1-5).

pred-lookahead.name: Look-ahead (frames)
pred-lookahead.description: How far into the future each test run simulates. Higher = safer but slower.

pred-hold.name: Assumed Hold (frames)
pred-hold.description: In the test run, assume you hold the click this long before letting go.
